Identity and homelands

Métis identity refers to a distinct Indigenous people with its own history, communities, political traditions, and homeland.

02

Historical context

Métis National Council sources connect national history with provisional governments, land struggles, and contemporary self-government efforts.

Read the sources [1] Métis National Council

03

Living communities and further study

The Council identifies Michif as foundational to national identity and supports language revitalization. Métis identity is not a generic synonym for mixed ancestry.
